component.name: Exposed Games
component.summary: One library for your games across launchers

description.p: Exposed Games brings your game libraries together, with search, artwork, game details, and actions through your existing game clients. Browse and manage supported mods with separate profiles for each game.

Keep your game clients installed and signed in. Exposed Games uses host command execution and filesystem access to discover libraries, start clients, and install mods, including games managed by Flatpak Steam.
